description: Abolished level crossings is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Infrabel. Om het aantal ongevallen te doen dalen, streeft Infrabel ernaar om zo veel mogelijk overwegen te doen verdwijnen en te vervangen door veiligere alternatieven. Dit is het aantal afgeschafte overwegen sinds 2010. Openbare overweg: De gelijkgrondse, gehele of gedeeltelijke kruising van een openbare weg door een of meer buiten de rijbaan aangelegde sporen. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are Overweg, Veiligheid. The portal shows 32 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-07-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
